T:P2.1.text: About Us | The Simply Good Foods Company

T:P2.2.text: At Simply Good Foods, our mission is to empower and educate consumers about how to eat right and snack smarter through our education, advocacy, products and tools. Our vision is to lead the nutritional snacking movement with trusted brands that offer a rich variety of innovative, convenient, better-for-you snacks and meals that provide optimal nutrition for everyone.

T:P2.3.text: With our heritage of science-based nutrition, we are committed to growing our portfolio of nutritious snacking brands. We distribute our products in major retail channels including grocery, club and mass merchandise, as well as through e-commerce, convenience, specialty and other channels. Our strong platform allows us to introduce new products, expand distribution, and appeal to current and potential consumers. We are well-positioned to continue to selectively pursue acquisition opportunities in the nutritious snacking and broader health and wellness food space.

C:P2.3.text: Bringing your family delicious food for more than 125 years.

C:P2.4.text: We’re committed to acquiring and investing in established food brands and making them more relevant for our customers and consumers. Our growth strategy ensures that we change from one day to the next, always improving, but one thing remains constant: delicious food from our family to yours.

C:P2.5.text: Everything we do is about making sure you get great-tasting, high-quality foods that you can feel good about feeding your family.

C:P2.6.text: Together with our predecessors, we have been doing so since the 1800s.

C:P2.7.text: We love food and bringing our family of brands to you and your family. We pursue excellence in everything we do. We are energized by new challenges.

C:P2.8.text: We are ethical, honest and transparent. We hold ourselves accountable for our decisions and actions. We believe in being a good corporate citizen, and we do the right thing because we care.

C:P2.9.text: We strive to consistently exceed our customers’ and consumers’ expectations. We proactively seek customer and consumer insights. We deliver what we promise.

C:P2.11.text: We are committed to preventing accidents, injuries and illnesses related to the workplace.

C:P2.12.text: We make food safety our number one priority. We are committed to providing great-tasting, high-quality and safe foods to you and your family.

C:P2.13.text: We leverage diverse backgrounds and perspectives to achieve outstanding results. We are committed to fostering an inclusive work environment where all employees have the opportunity to share their ideas, grow with our company, and realize their full potential.

C:P2.14.text: We believe in team first, individuals second. We believe in timely and personal communication. We support each other professionally and personally without being asked.

C:P2.15.text: We strive to hire people more talented than we are.

C:S1.1.text: B&G Foods has a portfolio of multiple brands, including B&G, B&M, Bear Creek, Cream of Wheat, Crisco, Dash, Green Giant, Las Palmas, Le Sueur, Mama Mary's, Maple Grove Farms, New York Style, Ortega, Polaner, Spice Islands and Victoria.

C:S2.1.text: B&G bought maple syrup and salad dressing producer Maple Grove Farms of Vermont and its natural foods brand Up Country Naturals in July 1998.

C:S3.1.text: B&G Foods, which will retain ownership of the Green Giant trademarks, will license the Green Giant brand name to Seneca Foods.
